description: COPILOT_HOME replaces ~/.copilot, so process logs are written to $COPILOT_HOME/logs/process-<timestamp>-<pid>.log.
note: Path-only characterization: upstream documents COPILOT_HOME as replacing ~/.copilot, but Telltale does not read it. As in home-process-log, the official v1.0.96 Linux runtime archive (SHA256 e6c9513e7dcff38e424c247a8ae7b5b8a283e93973b77eb31fba9ef769f1c95b) documents the named default log level as info without establishing the adapter-required accumulated-output format when invoked without logging flags. The copied Telltale fixture is not upstream output. Relocated discovery and supported promotion remain blocked on authoritative format/default-level evidence and successful discovery plus acquisition; do not infer events.jsonl or session-store.db schemas. No live capture was performed.
